governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust; PHI/clinical gates flagged.

candidates.intent: Read a FHIR Patient resource (demographics, identifiers, contacts) by patient ID or search params from any FHIR R4 server.

candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed on repo; PHI — Patient demographics are protected health information, must run behind tenant auth + audit logging + HIPAA BAA; never cache to global store.

candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm before relying. PHI — lab/vital values are clinical data; gate behind tenant auth + audit; values must be read, never interpreted-as-truth by the model.

candidates.intent: Parse an HL7 v2.x message (ADT, ORU, ORM, etc.) into structured segments/fields/components for any supported HL7 version (2.1-2.8.2).

candidates.intent: Create and validate HL7 v2.x messages against the HL7 specification (segment cardinality, datatypes, required fields).

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds spec-validated HL7 v2 message construction with structural/datatype checks before serialization.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed on repo. Clinical-safety — generated HL7 messages can drive orders/results; validate and require human/system gate before transmission.

candidates.intent: Parse HL7 v2.x messages into navigable Python objects with simple segment/field accessors.

candidates.output_contract: parsed message objects with indexed segment and field access
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably index HL7 v2 fields/repetitions by position, especially with escaped delimiters.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a lightweight, well-tested HL7 v2 parser exposing positional segment/field access.
candidates.verify_note: BSD-3-Clause is the well-known license for python-hl7 — confirm on the LICENSE file (page did not name it explicitly). PHI — HL7 payloads carry patient data.

candidates.intent: Transform an incoming HL7 v2 message into a normalized JSON object suitable for downstream processing.

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a reference HL7-v2->JSON transform (built on hl7apy) for serverless ingestion pipelines.
candidates.verify_note: aws-samples repos are typically MIT-0 — confirm on the LICENSE file. PHI — output JSON contains patient data; secure the pipeline and storage.

candidates.intent: Look up U.S. healthcare providers in the NPPES NPI Registry by NPI number, name, specialty/taxonomy, or location.

candidates.intent: Look up ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and descriptions, and validate/normalize a given ICD-10 code.

candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Clinical-coding errors have billing/clinical consequences; treat code suggestions as candidates needing coder review (not PHI itself).

candidates.intent: Search across SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, medications, procedures, surgeries, and biobank samples by free text to find matching coded concepts.

HIGH clinical-safety — interaction checks inform prescribing; deterministic gate + clinician review required; not a substitute for a maintained DDI source.

candidates.intent: Compute estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) using the CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation and stage CKD per KDIGO.

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR implementation with KDIGO staging, returning a reproducible number.

candidates.intent: Compute the CHA2DS2-VASc stroke-risk score for non-valvular atrial fibrillation from clinical risk factors.

candidates.output_contract: integer CHA2DS2-VASc score (0-9) with the standard risk interpretation band

candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic CHA2DS2-VASc scoring function with correct point weighting and the canonical interpretation.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated (reference calculator site) — implement the published formula directly rather than depending on a site. HIGH clinical-safety — score guides anticoagulation; deterministic implementation + clinician interpretation required. Risk-factor inputs may be PHI.

candidates.intent: Compute body mass index (BMI) and body surface area (BSA) from height and weight using standard formulas.

candidates.verify_note: License not stated — confirm; implement the published equation directly if license is unclear. HIGH clinical-safety — CrCl drives renal dose adjustment; deterministic + clinician review. Inputs may be PHI.

candidates.output_contract: the computed value with units and the equation used

candidates.intent: Parse and analyze metadata across collections of DICOM files (summarize modalities, series, tag distributions).
candidates.input_contract: a directory/collection of DICOM files
candidates.output_contract: aggregated metadata report across the collection
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot batch-analyze DICOM metadata or summarize tag distributions across a study/collection.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a pydicom/fastcore toolkit for parsing and analyzing DICOM metadata in bulk.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. PHI — collections may contain identifiers; de-identify and secure; tenant-auth.

candidates.intent: De-identify DICOM files by removing/replacing protected header tags per de-identification profiles.
candidates.input_contract: DICOM file(s) plus a de-identification recipe/profile
candidates.output_contract: DICOM file(s) with PHI tags removed/replaced and an audit of changed tags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably enumerate every PHI-bearing DICOM tag (incl. private/embedded) to safely de-identify imaging.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the pydicom 'deid' tool that applies recipe-driven DICOM de-identification with an auditable change log.
candidates.verify_note: Part of the pydicom org (license likely MIT — confirm on the deid repo). HIGH PHI-safety — de-identification is a compliance control; validate against DICOM PS3.15 profiles and pixel-burned-in-text before declaring de-identified.

candidates.intent: Parse and query VCF/BCF genomic variant files (variants, genotypes, INFO/FORMAT fields) at scale.
candidates.input_contract: a VCF/BCF file (optionally region-restricted) and optional field selectors
candidates.output_contract: structured variant records with position, alleles, quality, INFO/FORMAT, and per-sample genotypes
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot parse the VCF/BCF binary/compressed format or correctly decode multi-sample genotype/FORMAT fields.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds cyvcf2 (htslib-backed) fast VCF/BCF parsing returning real variant and genotype records.
candidates.verify_note: cyvcf2 license MIT confirmed on repo. Genomic data is sensitive personal data (and PHI when clinically linked) — secure storage + access controls; clinical interpretation requires a separate gated step.

candidates.intent: Read VCF files into Python objects with record/sample accessors for downstream variant processing.
candidates.input_contract: a VCF file (optionally with a pysam-backed region index)
candidates.output_contract: VCF records with CHROM/POS/REF/ALT, INFO, and per-sample calls
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot parse VCF text robustly across header/INFO schema variation.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a pure-Python VCF reader exposing record and per-sample call objects.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm (PyVCF is commonly BSD-style). Genomic data sensitivity applies; PyVCF is less actively maintained than cyvcf2 — note for selection.

candidates.intent: Annotate variants in a VCF with technical annotations (depth, allele frequency, support) computed from one or more BAM files.
candidates.input_contract: a VCF plus one or more aligned BAM files
candidates.output_contract: the VCF augmented with per-variant technical annotation fields
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot compute read-level support/AF from BAMs to annotate variant confidence.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds VAFator (cyvcf2 + pysam) to annotate variants with BAM-derived depth/AF/support.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Genomic/clinical sensitivity applies; technical annotation is reproducible but interpretation is a separate gated step.

candidates.intent: Predict functional consequences of genomic variants (consequence terms, affected transcripts, ClinVar/gnomAD/SIFT annotations) via Ensembl VEP.
candidates.input_contract: variants as VCF, HGVS, or dbSNP/ClinVar identifiers, plus assembly/species
candidates.output_contract: per-variant consequence annotations with transcript impact, frequencies, and clinical significance references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot map variants to transcripts or recall ClinVar/gnomAD annotations and fabricates consequence calls.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Ensembl VEP (CLI/REST) returning real functional consequences and integrated ClinVar/gnomAD/SIFT annotations.
candidates.verify_note: Ensembl VEP is Apache-2.0 (well-known) — confirm on the LICENSE file. Genomic/clinical sensitivity applies; clinical-significance fields (ClinVar) are decision-relevant and require a gated clinical-genetics review, not model interpretation. Pin assembly/cache version.

candidates.intent: Look up a variant's clinical significance and condition associations in ClinVar by variant ID, rsID, or HGVS.
candidates.input_contract: a ClinVar variation ID, rsID, or HGVS expression
candidates.output_contract: ClinVar record with clinical significance, review status, conditions, and submitters
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve a variant's current ClinVar classification/review status and may invent pathogenicity calls.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP-mediated ClinVar (via MyVariant.info) retrieval returning real clinical significance and review status.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo (integrates MyVariant.info/ClinVar/gnomAD/CIViC/OncoKB). HIGH clinical-safety — pathogenicity is decision-relevant; return verbatim with review-status + submitter provenance; gated clinical-genetics interpretation. Variant data is sensitive.

candidates.intent: Fetch consolidated annotations for a genomic variant (dbSNP, ClinVar, gnomAD frequencies, CADD, functional predictions) from MyVariant.info.
candidates.input_contract: a variant identifier (HGVS/rsID) and assembly
candidates.output_contract: aggregated variant annotation document across multiple sources
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot aggregate multi-source variant annotations or recall current allele frequencies.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP's variant 'get' over MyVariant.info returning the consolidated annotation document.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo. Clinical-safety — frequency/prediction fields inform interpretation but are not diagnoses; gate clinical use. Variant data is sensitive; do not store globally if patient-linked.

candidates.intent: Run a unified search across 30+ biomedical sources (clinical trials, PubMed/PubTator3, variants, genes, drugs, diseases) with cross-entity pivots.
candidates.input_contract: an entity type plus a query (e.g., gene, variant, trial, drug, disease)
candidates.output_contract: ranked records from the relevant authoritative sources with detail cards and pivots
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query live biomedical databases or pivot across genes/variants/trials/drugs with real identifiers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP's unified search/get grammar over ClinicalTrials.gov, PubTator3, MyVariant/MyGene/MyChem, ChEMBL, OpenFDA, MONDO, and more.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo (30+ sources, unified command grammar). Each underlying source has its own terms — verify per-source. Clinical-safety — synthesis across sources still needs verification; not clinical advice.

candidates.intent: Agent-oriented biomedical R&D search/retrieval over biomedical databases for variants, trials, and literature.
candidates.input_contract: a biomedical query (variant/trial/article)
candidates.output_contract: structured biomedical records for the query
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reach biomedical R&D databases directly for grounded variant/trial/literature retrieval.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an alternative biomedical MCP server enabling agent-based R&D retrieval over biomedical sources.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm; overlaps genomoncology/biomcp (prefer the more-maintained one). Per-source terms apply; not clinical advice.

candidates.intent: Extract and link clinical entities (conditions, medications, findings) from free clinical text to UMLS/SNOMED concepts (NER+L).
candidates.input_contract: free-text clinical note plus a configured MedCAT model/vocabulary
candidates.output_contract: recognized entities with spans, linked CUIs/SNOMED codes, and confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare LLM does span-level entity linking inconsistently and cannot guarantee valid CUIs/SNOMED codes for extracted terms.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds MedCAT NER+L returning entities linked to validated UMLS/SNOMED concepts with confidence, callable as a service.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on docs page — confirm on the GitHub repo (CogStack/MedCAT; the docs URL is given because the sweep surfaced it). UMLS/SNOMED linking requires the relevant vocabulary license. PHI — clinical notes are protected; run in-tenant. NER+L is non-deterministic ML — linked codes are candidates for review.

candidates.intent: Detect clinical context modifiers on extracted entities (negation, uncertainty, family history, historical) and segment clinical-note sections.
candidates.input_contract: free-text clinical note (with or without pre-extracted entities)
candidates.output_contract: entities annotated with context attributes (negated, hypothetical, family, historical) and note section labels
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model inconsistently distinguishes 'no chest pain' from 'chest pain', or family-history vs current, which flips clinical meaning.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds medspaCy (ConText algorithm + section detection) for deterministic-leaning negation/uncertainty/family-history tagging.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm (medspaCy is commonly MIT). scispaCy biomedical NER (allenai/scispacy) is the adjacent companion library for this slot. PHI — operates on clinical notes; run in-tenant. ConText is rule-based but imperfect — assertions need review before clinical use.

candidates.intent: Extract structured clinical information (named entities, attributes, relations) from electronic medical record free text using Apache cTAKES.
candidates.input_contract: clinical free-text documents
candidates.output_contract: cTAKES annotations (mentions, UMLS concept mappings, attributes) as structured output
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot replicate cTAKES' pipeline of tokenization->dictionary lookup->UMLS mapping with consistent concept identifiers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Apache cTAKES clinical NLP returning UMLS-mapped mentions/attributes from EMR free text.
candidates.verify_note: Apache cTAKES is Apache-2.0 (well-known) — confirm on the repo. Requires a UMLS license for the dictionary. PHI — processes EMR text; run in-tenant with audit. Extraction is a candidate signal needing review.

candidates.intent: Run an integrated clinical NLP pipeline (biomedical NER + UMLS linking + negation) over clinical text via spaCy/scispaCy/medspaCy.
candidates.input_contract: clinical free-text plus model selection
candidates.output_contract: entities with UMLS concepts and negation flags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reproduce a consistent NER+linking+negation pipeline across notes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds clinspacy, bundling scispaCy/medspaCy for NER, UMLS mapping, and negation in one pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. UMLS license needed for concept mapping. PHI — clinical text; in-tenant only. ML pipeline output is candidate-only.

candidates.intent: Assess data-quality of FHIR resources (completeness, conformance, coding gaps) and surface patients/resources with quality issues.
candidates.input_contract: FHIR base URL and a resource/query scope
candidates.output_contract: data-quality findings (missing fields, non-conformant codings, gaps) per resource
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot systematically profile a FHIR dataset for conformance/completeness issues.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an enhanced FHIR MCP server with data-quality assessment over real resources.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. PHI — reads real patient resources; tenant-auth + audit + BAA; quality findings are candidates, not clinical judgments.

candidates.intent: Validate, search, and navigate ICD-10 codes/blocks/chapters via a Python ICD-10 package.
candidates.input_contract: an ICD-10 code or a search term
candidates.output_contract: code validity, description, and chapter/block hierarchy
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot validate ICD-10 code structure (chapter/block ranges) or expand hierarchies reliably.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a maintained Python ICD-10 package for offline code validation and hierarchy navigation.
candidates.verify_note: Source is a GitHub Topics listing, not a single repo — SELECT and verify a specific package + its license before use (no single source_url verified). Coding output needs coder review; not PHI.

candidates.intent: Look up LOINC codes for laboratory/clinical observations and resolve a LOINC code to its component/property/system/method parts.
candidates.input_contract: a LOINC code or a lab-test name/component
candidates.output_contract: LOINC code with long common name and the six-axis parts (component, property, time, system, scale, method)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model invents LOINC codes or mis-assigns lab tests, and cannot decompose the six-axis LOINC structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds LOINC lookup returning real codes and their six-axis decomposition for lab observations.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm; LOINC content is governed by the Regenstrief LOINC license — verify use/redistribution terms. Coding output needs review; not PHI.

candidates.intent: Interpret a lab result against its reference range to flag low/normal/high/critical, given the value, units, and range.
candidates.input_contract: a lab analyte, numeric value, units, and reference range (and optional critical thresholds)
candidates.output_contract: an interpretation flag (low/normal/high/critical) with the comparison performed
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model freehand-comparing values to ranges mishandles units and inverted/age-specific ranges, producing wrong flags.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic value-vs-range comparison (sourced from FHIR Observation reference ranges) returning a reproducible flag.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. HIGH clinical-safety — range flagging is the deterministic part ONLY; clinical INTERPRETATION/diagnosis must remain a gated clinician step. Values may be PHI.

candidates.intent: Query openFDA across drug and device datasets (adverse events/FAERS, labels, NDC directory, recalls, Drugs@FDA, shortages; device 510(k), classifications, MDR, recalls) through one MCP server.
candidates.input_contract: an openFDA dataset selector plus search parameters (drug name, NDC, device name, date range)
candidates.output_contract: matching openFDA records for the selected dataset as structured JSON
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query live openFDA datasets across drugs and devices and fabricates adverse-event counts, NDCs, and 510(k) numbers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a single MCP surface over the openFDA API spanning drug + device datasets with real records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Distinct from the already-seeded single-purpose openFDA slots (this is a multi-dataset server). Regulatory data — adverse-event/recall data is decision-relevant; cite the dataset + retrieval date; FAERS reports are not causation. Not PHI.

candidates.intent: Look up products in the FDA National Drug Code (NDC) Directory by NDC, brand, or generic name to resolve product/package details.
candidates.input_contract: an NDC code or a brand/generic drug name
candidates.output_contract: NDC Directory records with product type, dosage form, route, labeler, and package codes
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve a real NDC to its product/package metadata and invents NDC numbers and labeler info.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the openFDA NDC Directory endpoint returning authoritative product/package records.
candidates.verify_note: Official openFDA endpoint (US Gov public data, updated daily). NDC directory is reference data, not PHI; confirm currency (daily refresh). Distinct from already-seeded openfda-drug-label/recall/shortage/adverse-event slots.

candidates.intent: Find medical device establishments and the devices they manufacture via the openFDA device registration & listing dataset.
candidates.input_contract: a device name, establishment, or registration number
candidates.output_contract: establishment locations and associated device listings
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot recall which establishments are registered for a device or their locations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the openFDA device registration/listing endpoint returning real establishment and device records.
candidates.verify_note: Official openFDA endpoint (US Gov public data). Reference/regulatory data, not PHI. Distinct from the already-seeded device-510k slot.

candidates.intent: Serve a unified US drug API built from openFDA NDC + label data and RxNorm, joining product and package records.
candidates.input_contract: a drug name or NDC/RxCUI
candidates.output_contract: merged drug record (product + package + RxNorm normalization + label fields)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot join NDC, label, and RxNorm data into a single coherent drug record.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a prebuilt service that ingests openFDA NDC/label + RxNorm and exposes merged drug records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Combines US Gov sources (openFDA/RxNorm). Reference data, not PHI; volatile (labels/NDC change) — pair with versioning before promotion.

candidates.intent: Search CMS Medicare data: providers/practitioners, Part D prescribers, hospital utilization/payment, drug spending trends, Part D formulary coverage, and hospital star ratings.
candidates.input_contract: a method selector (search_providers/prescribers/hospitals/spending/formulary/star_rating) plus query params
candidates.output_contract: CMS Medicare records for the selected method as structured JSON
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot recall CMS provider/prescriber/spending/formulary figures and fabricates payment amounts and star ratings.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an MCP server over data.cms.gov returning real Medicare provider, prescriber, hospital, spending, and formulary records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Public CMS data, no auth, updated quarterly. Provider/claims aggregates are public (not PHI); confirm the quarter/vintage before relying.

candidates.intent: Access Medicaid public data (incl. provider-level T-MSIS claims) via data.medicaid.gov through a hybrid CSV + DKAN API MCP server.
candidates.input_contract: a Medicaid dataset selector plus query parameters
candidates.output_contract: Medicaid public records as structured JSON
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query data.medicaid.gov datasets or recall T-MSIS provider-level figures.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an MCP server over data.medicaid.gov (CSV + DKAN) returning real Medicaid public records.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Public HHS/T-MSIS data (aggregated/public, not PHI); confirm dataset vintage. Distinct from the Medicare server.

candidates.intent: Access CMS healthcare datasets directly from data.cms.gov (DCAT catalog + datastore query) for provider, quality, and payment data.
candidates.input_contract: a CMS dataset identifier plus datastore query parameters
candidates.output_contract: rows from the requested CMS dataset
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate CMS datasets or run datastore queries against data.cms.gov.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an MCP server that gives an agent direct catalog + datastore access to data.cms.gov.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Public CMS data (not PHI). Overlaps openpharma medicare-mcp — prefer per use case; confirm dataset vintage.

candidates.intent: Look up European Medicines Agency (EMA) drug approvals, EPARs, and orphan designations / EU regulatory data.
candidates.input_contract: a medicine name or EMA product/approval identifier
candidates.output_contract: EMA approval records, EPAR references, and orphan-designation status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot recall EU/EMA approval status, EPAR documents, or orphan designations accurately.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an MCP server returning real EMA approval/EPAR/orphan-designation records for EU regulatory queries.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. EMA public regulatory data (not PHI). Regulatory facts are decision-relevant; cite source + retrieval date. Complements the US openFDA slots with EU coverage.

candidates.intent: Look up Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) descriptors, tree numbers, and relationships via the NLM MeSH RDF REST/SPARQL service.
candidates.input_contract: a MeSH term or descriptor ID (e.g., D015242)
candidates.output_contract: MeSH descriptor record with preferred term, tree numbers, and related concepts
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve MeSH descriptor IDs to tree numbers/hierarchy and fabricates MeSH identifiers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the NLM MeSH RDF REST/SPARQL endpoint returning real descriptors, tree numbers, and relationships.
candidates.verify_note: Official NLM linked-data service (US Gov public data; free download in XML/ASCII). Reference vocabulary, not PHI.

candidates.intent: Traverse the MeSH ontology tree (parents/children/descriptor lookup) using prebuilt MeSH data structures.
candidates.input_contract: a MeSH descriptor or tree number
candidates.output_contract: ancestors/descendants and descriptor metadata within the MeSH tree
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably walk MeSH parent/child relationships offline.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds user-friendly MeSH datasets (mesh.json) and helpers for offline tree traversal.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Derives from NLM MeSH (public). Reference data, not PHI.

candidates.intent: Resolve disease terms/IDs in the Mondo Disease Ontology and retrieve cross-references to OMIM/Orphanet/ICD/SNOMED via the Ontology Lookup Service.
candidates.input_contract: a disease name or Mondo ID (MONDO:xxxxxxx)
candidates.output_contract: Mondo term with label, definition, synonyms, hierarchy, and cross-references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot map a disease to a stable Mondo ID or its cross-references and conflates disease-ontology identifiers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Mondo lookups (via OLS/release files) returning stable disease IDs with harmonized cross-references.
candidates.verify_note: Mondo is commonly CC-BY-4.0 — confirm on the release/repo. Reference ontology, not PHI. Cross-references (e.g., SNOMED) may inherit source license terms.

candidates.intent: Look up Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms for clinical features and retrieve disease-phenotype annotations.
candidates.input_contract: a phenotype description or HPO ID (HP:xxxxxxx)
candidates.output_contract: HPO term with label, definition, hierarchy, and linked disease annotations
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve clinical features to stable HPO IDs (18k+ terms) or recall disease-phenotype annotations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds HPO term resolution + disease-phenotype annotations (156k+) for phenotype-driven workflows.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm (HPO has its own use license). Reference ontology, not PHI; phenotype data becomes sensitive when patient-linked.

candidates.intent: Retrieve expert-curated clinical interpretations of cancer variants (evidence items, therapeutic/diagnostic/prognostic assertions) from the CIViC GraphQL API.
candidates.input_contract: a gene, variant, or CIViC entity identifier
candidates.output_contract: CIViC evidence items and assertions with evidence level, direction, disease, and therapy context
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve curated cancer-variant clinical evidence and may invent therapeutic implications.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the CIViC GraphQL API returning expert-curated, evidence-leveled cancer-variant interpretations.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm (CIViC content is open-access; check terms/citation). HIGH clinical-safety — therapeutic implications are decision-relevant; return with evidence level + citations; gated oncology review, not model interpretation.

candidates.intent: Resolve which cancer clinical knowledge bases/databases cover a given variant/gene (a community-maintained directory of cancer-variant resources, incl. CIViC/OncoKB/VICC).
candidates.input_contract: a gene/variant or resource-capability query
candidates.output_contract: list of relevant cancer-variant knowledge bases with access/links
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has a stale/partial map of cancer-variant knowledge bases and their access methods.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a maintained directory so an agent routes a variant query to the right curated knowledge base.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. This is a routing/directory resource (discovery, not trust); each downstream KB (OncoKB requires a license/token) has its own terms. Not PHI.

candidates.intent: Resolve genomics/bioinformatics agentic skills and MCPs (variant calling, RNA-seq, population genetics) from a curated registry for AI coding agents.
candidates.input_contract: a genomics/bioinformatics task description
candidates.output_contract: matching skills/MCPs with repo links and applicability notes
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model does not know the current landscape of genomics agent skills/MCPs or which fits a task.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a curated genomics skill/MCP registry so an agent selects the right tool for variant calling/RNA-seq/etc.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Curated list = discovery substrate (discovery is not trust); each listed skill/MCP carries its own license + validation needs. Not PHI.

candidates.intent: Provide procedural SKILLS.md know-how for common bioinformatics tasks (sequence manipulation, single-cell RNA-seq, population genetics) to coding agents.
candidates.input_contract: a bioinformatics task plus relevant data/tooling context
candidates.output_contract: step-by-step skill procedure (and optional scripts) for the task
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model lacks reliable, reproducible procedures for bioinformatics workflows and improvises inconsistent steps.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds reproducible bioinformatics skill procedures that constrain how an agent executes common analyses.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page — confirm. Skill packs are procedural guidance (candidate), not verified outputs; results must be validated. Not PHI unless run on patient data.

candidates.intent: Resolve CDC CVX (vaccine administered) and MVX (manufacturer) codes, including CVX<->CPT mappings, for immunization messaging.
candidates.input_contract: a CVX/MVX code or a vaccine/manufacturer name
candidates.output_contract: the code record with vaccine/manufacturer name, status (active/inactive), and CPT mapping where applicable
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model invents CVX/MVX codes or mis-maps vaccines to CPT, and cannot track active/inactive status.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the authoritative CDC CVX/MVX code sets with CPT crosswalks for immunization data exchange.
candidates.verify_note: Authoritative CDC NCIRD code set (US Gov public data; periodic releases). Codes are reference data, not PHI; CPT mappings touch AMA-licensed CPT — verify CPT use terms.

candidates.intent: Read FHIR Immunization resources to enumerate a patient's vaccination history with CVX coding, dates, and status.
candidates.input_contract: FHIR base URL plus patient reference
candidates.output_contract: FHIR Immunization resources with vaccine code (CVX), occurrence date, and status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve a patient's real vaccination record and fabricates vaccines/dates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an Immunization read returning the patient's actual coded vaccination history from the FHIR store.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed on repo (Immunization is among its supported resources). PHI — immunization records are clinical; tenant-auth + audit + BAA.

candidates.intent: Fetch gene annotations (symbol, aliases, genomic location, function, cross-DB IDs) from MyGene.info via BioMCP.
candidates.input_contract: a gene symbol or identifier (Entrez/Ensembl/HGNC)
candidates.output_contract: consolidated gene annotation document with identifiers and functional metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve current gene identifiers/aliases or recall genomic coordinates reliably.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP gene 'get' over MyGene.info returning the consolidated, cross-referenced gene record.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo (integrates MyGene.info). Reference data, not PHI. Complements the already-seeded biothings-gene-annotation by routing through the BioMCP grammar.

candidates.intent: Fetch consolidated disease annotations (MONDO mapping, synonyms, cross-references, associated phenotypes) from MyDisease.info via BioMCP.
candidates.input_contract: a disease name or ontology ID (MONDO/DOID/OMIM)
candidates.output_contract: consolidated disease annotation document with harmonized cross-references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve a disease to a stable ontology ID with harmonized cross-references.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP disease 'get' over MyDisease.info returning harmonized disease annotations.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo (integrates MyDisease.info/MONDO). Reference data, not PHI.

candidates.intent: Fetch consolidated drug/chemical annotations (ChEMBL, Drugs@FDA, identifiers, mechanism) from MyChem.info via BioMCP.
candidates.input_contract: a drug name or chemical identifier (RxCUI/ChEMBL/InChIKey)
candidates.output_contract: consolidated drug annotation document across sources
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot aggregate multi-source drug identifiers/mechanism into one coherent record.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds BioMCP drug 'get' over MyChem.info returning the consolidated drug annotation document.
candidates.verify_note: BioMCP license MIT confirmed on repo (integrates MyChem.info/ChEMBL/Drugs@FDA). Reference data, not PHI. Complements the already-seeded ChEMBL slots.

candidates.intent: Fetch detailed clinical-trial records (eligibility, arms, interventions, locations, status) from ClinicalTrials.gov / NCI CTS via BioMCP.
candidates.input_contract: an NCT number or trial search query
candidates.output_contract: structured trial record with eligibility, phase, interventions, sites, and status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve a real trial's current eligibility/status and fabricates NCT details.
